name: Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Radon Number (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}=\lceil n/2\rceil$, whereas $\mathrm{Rad}=\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor=\Theta(\log n)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm{Rad}=n$, whereas $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}=1$.
proof: The established full-cube and singleton values yield unbounded gaps in both directions.
